name: ATM Grupa S.A.
summary: ATM Grupa S.A. functions as an independent television and film production company, extending its operations across Poland, Europe, North America, and South America. The company's content portfolio spans a diverse range of programming, including music, current affairs, game, comedy, reality, crime, and political fiction series, in addition to producing or co-producing feature films. Beyond its screen productions, ATM Grupa develops and markets games for personal computers and mobile devices, and orchestrates various events. It also manages the Bielany Stage, a venue for performances by Polish theatre companies, and participates in building development. Furthermore, the company delivers comprehensive post-production solutions, encompassing media storage, film and sound editing, voice-over recording, color correction, and media export. Its rental offerings feature film studios, outside broadcast (OB) vans, and an extensive selection of production equipment such as cameras, lenses, lighting, grip, and sound gear, complemented by logistical and creative support. ATM Grupa S.A., founded in 1992 and headquartered in Bielany Wroclawskie, Poland, caters to both broadcasters and the viewing public.
